subject: design-technology
title: Cooking Methods
welcome_lead: Boil, bake, grill, fry, steam — pick the right one.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T food: cooking methods and effects on food.
final_note: Different methods give different textures and flavours.

walkthroughs.body_html: Boiling happens at 100°C in bubbling water. Steaming uses steam above the water — gentler on vitamins. Both are healthy (no oil needed).
Baking and roasting use the dry heat of an oven, around 180-220°C. Grilling uses fierce heat from above — great for browning.
Frying uses hot oil. Shallow frying = a thin film of oil. Deep frying = submerged in oil. Adds flavour but also fat and calories — eat in moderation.
